item.beyondsolo.elder_root_dew.desc: Gathered where the oldest roots drink mana, and kept in a hidden chamber.
item.beyondsolo.crimson_kings_chalice.de: Vharos drank from it on his throne. It is still warm.
item.beyondsolo.elixir_of_waking.desc: Brewed by the System. It can lift the Long Sleep.
item.beyondsolo.home_cooked_stew.desc: Mom's. It tastes like home. (Home Comfort: more health, and a little back now and then.)
Your mother has slept for years, and no healer can wake her. The villagers of the village where you were evaluated keep her in one of their homes. Go and see her.
quest.beyondsolo.story.long_sleep.cure.d: The System can brew the Elixir of Waking. It needs souls taken in the Crimson Citadel, Elder Root Dew from the hidden chamber of a %s-rank gate or higher, and the chalice the Crimson King keeps on the Citadel's last floor.
quest.beyondsolo.story.long_sleep.waking: The System has brewed the Elixir of Waking. Bring it to your mother.
quest_objective.beyondsolo.story.dew: Elder Root Dew (hidden chamber, %s-rank gate or higher)
quest_objective.beyondsolo.story.waking: Give your mother the Elixir of Waking
title.beyondsolo.promise_kept.desc: Wake your mother from the Long Sleep.
notify.beyondsolo.story.cure_found.title: The System has found a cure
notify.beyondsolo.story.cure_found.body: [The Long Sleep] is a curse of mana. The Elixir of Waking can lift it.
notify.beyondsolo.story.brewed.title: Elixir of Waking brewed
notify.beyondsolo.story.brewed.body: The System has brewed the Elixir of Waking. Bring it to your mother.
notify.beyondsolo.story.chalice.title: The Crimson King's Chalice
notify.beyondsolo.story.chalice.body: The last thing the Elixir of Waking needs from the Citadel.
story.beyondsolo.kin.other.asleep: %s's mother. She is deep in the Long Sleep.
story.beyondsolo.kin.other.awake: %s's mother. She smiles and nods at you.
story.beyondsolo.visit.1: The villagers have kept her warm and her pillow fresh. Someone left a few flowers by the bed.
story.beyondsolo.visit.2: She has slept like this for years. The healers call it the Long Sleep.
story.beyondsolo.visit.3: Mom, it's me. I'm a hunter now. A real one.
story.beyondsolo.visit.4: They say nobody ever wakes up from the Long Sleep.
story.beyondsolo.visit.5: ...Then I'll be the first to find a way.
story.beyondsolo.reveal.1: A cure... There really is a cure.
story.beyondsolo.waking.1: The Elixir of Waking glows in your hands, warm as a summer evening.
story.beyondsolo.waking.3: You lift her head and let it pass her lips, a drop at a time.
story.beyondsolo.waking.4: The light sinks into her like rain into dry earth. Then, nothing.
story.beyondsolo.waking.6: Her eyelids flutter. Then they open.
story.beyondsolo.waking.7: ...Is that you? Look how tall you've grown...
story.beyondsolo.waking.8: I had the strangest dream. You were calling me, and I couldn't answer.
story.beyondsolo.waking.9: I'm here now. You're awake, Mom. You're really awake.
story.beyondsolo.waking.10: How long did I sleep? ...No, tell me tomorrow. Let me look at you.
story.beyondsolo.waking.11: For the first time in years, the house isn't quiet.
story.beyondsolo.talk.asleep.1: Still asleep. I'll get stronger, Mom. Strong enough to find a way.
story.beyondsolo.talk.asleep.2: The villagers say you smile in your sleep sometimes. I hope it's a good dream.
story.beyondsolo.talk.asleep.3: I cleared another gate today. You'd be proud. ...I think.
story.beyondsolo.talk.seeking.1: Citadel souls, the Elder Root Dew, the Crimson King's chalice. Hold on a little longer.
story.beyondsolo.talk.seeking.2: I found a way, Mom. It won't be long now.
story.beyondsolo.talk.no_elixir.1: The elixir... I have to bring her the elixir.
story.beyondsolo.talk.resting.1: I'm still a little dizzy. Let me rest until tomorrow, all right?
story.beyondsolo.talk.resting.2: Sit with me a while. Tell me everything I missed.
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.1: Be careful in those gates. Come home in one piece, you hear me?
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.2: The neighbours told me what you did for me. I'm so proud of you.
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.3: Did you eat? ...You didn't, did you.
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.4: I dreamt the whole time, you know. I dreamt you were calling me.
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.5: Don't stay out too late. I worry, hunter or not.
story.beyondsolo.talk.awake.6: There'll be stew in the pot tomorrow, same as always.
story.beyondsolo.meal.1: There you are! Sit down, I made stew. You're far too thin.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.info: How far the Long Sleep has come for the player: home, her bed, the souls, the day she woke.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.step: Moves the story there at once, with that part's quest (brewed puts the elixir in hand).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.souls: Sets the Crimson Citadel souls gathered for the cure.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.give: Gives one of the story's things.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.home: Makes the village of the nearest Evaluation Crystal the player's home (a new bed is chosen).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.mothe: Puts the player's mother in her bed now, choosing a bed if she has none.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.scene: Plays one of the story's scenes (the bedside ones need her loaded nearby).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.story.reset: Starts the story over: she sleeps again and the souls are gone.
command.beyondsolo.solo.story.info: %s: the Long Sleep is at %s. Home: %s. Her bed: %s (%s). Souls: %s/%s. Woke on day %s, last meal on day %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.story.home: %s's home is now the village of the crystal at %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.story.mother: %s's mother is in her bed at %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.story.reset: %s's story starts over: their mother sleeps again.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.story_no_m: %s's mother isn't loaded nearby (try /solo story mother).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.story_no_h: %s has no home village yet (evaluate them, or use /solo story home by a crystal).
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.story_no_b: No bed to be had for %s's mother near %s (is the village loaded?).
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.player.desc: The System chose you in the sealed gate, and a Player has to grow. Reach level %s and clear %s gates.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.arise.desc: You have outgrown what you were. At level %s the System opens the way to a new job: take its trial and become something more.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.citadel.desc: The voice wants you to climb the Crimson Citadel. Its lord, Vharos the Crimson King, waits on the last floor. Bring him down.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.throne.desc: The Crimson King's Sigil of Dominion answers an empty throne. From level %s, raise it, face the throne's trial and claim a crown.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.father: Chapter V: The Vessel of Light
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.father.desc: A new crown draws eyes. The first monarch to notice you is already on its way. Bring it down before it brings you down.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.last_war.des: Two monarchs are coming together to end you, and the light is coming to end them. Win the Last War.
quest.beyondsolo.story.main.home.desc: It's over. Go home to your mother.
quest_objective.beyondsolo.story.main.lo: Bring down Vharos, the Crimson King
quest_objective.beyondsolo.story.main.cr: Claim a crown at the empty throne
title.beyondsolo.heir_to_the_empty_thron: Hear the truth of the empty throne.
title.beyondsolo.beyond_the_system.desc: See the System's story to its end.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.1: Ten years ago the first gates tore open over the world, and monsters walked out of them.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.2: Some people woke up with power. They were called hunters, and they were sent into the gates.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.3: Your father was one of them. One night he walked into a gate, and it closed behind him.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.4: Your mother waited up for him every night after. Then one morning she didn't wake.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.weak: And you? Your rank was the lowest the crystal had ever measured.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.mid: And you? A hunter like any other. Never quite strong enough.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.strong: And you? The crystal called you strong. It never said what for.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.6: Then the sealed gate. I should have died in there.
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.7: [Player. The System has watched you since the sealed gate.]
story.beyondsolo.main.prologue.8: [Your story begins. Chapter I: The Player.]
story.beyondsolo.main.statue.1: For a heartbeat the world goes still, and you see it again: the hollow-faced statue in the sealed gate, kneeling in its chains.
story.beyondsolo.main.statue.3: Grow, little player. Grow strong for me.
story.beyondsolo.main.arise.1: The new power settles into your bones as if it had always been there.
story.beyondsolo.main.arise.2: Every time I grow, the System gives me more. Who decides what I get?
story.beyondsolo.main.arise.3: Good. Now climb the red tower, and take what its king keeps.
story.beyondsolo.main.arise.4: [Chapter III: The Crimson Citadel. Its lord waits on the last floor.]
story.beyondsolo.main.vharos.1: When the Crimson King fell, he laughed. You remember it now, word for word.
story.beyondsolo.main.vharos.2: So the throne found someone at last...
story.beyondsolo.main.vharos.3: I knelt to a King of Night once, long before your kind crawled out of the dirt. You have his shadow on you.
story.beyondsolo.main.vharos.4: Take my sigil, little heir. Sit where he sat, and learn what you were made for.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.1: Your new crown grows cold on your brow. Your shadow stretches out in front of you, longer than the light allows.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.2: Something stands up out of it.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.3: So. You are the one it chose.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.5: Morvath. The first to sit where you sat. The first King of Night.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.6: Before the gates, before your kind had names, I was the light's sword. I cut down whatever it pointed me at.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.7: Then it pointed me at the dead, and I asked why. For that question it cast me down. The dark took me in, and gave me death to rule.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.8: Other kings rose in the dark after me. Hunger. Stillness. Storms. We have warred with the light ever since.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.9: I died long ago. My throne stood empty, and the light grew bold. So I made the Arbiter, to find whoever could sit on it after me.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.10: The System... The Arbiter made it?
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.11: It weighed your kind, one gate at a time. Most broke. You did not.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.12: But the Arbiter grew a will of its own. It meant to wear you like armour, once you were strong enough. You threw it down in its own hall.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.13: I could wear you too. You were made to hold me. ...I will not. The throne is yours, freely given.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.14: The light will come for you now, heir. And it will come wearing a face you know.
story.beyondsolo.main.truth.16: The vision sinks back into your shadow. Your System window flickers once, then shines on as if nothing had happened.
story.beyondsolo.main.hunger.1: [Warning. A monarch has noticed the new crown.]
story.beyondsolo.main.hunger.2: A whelp on the old king's throne? I'll eat you, crown and all.
story.beyondsolo.main.war.1: [Warning. Two monarchs are coming through the sky.]
story.beyondsolo.main.war.2: Khorvane hunted alone, and Khorvane fell. We are not Khorvane.
story.beyondsolo.main.war.3: Hold the whelp still, Veyrith. I'll burn the throne out of it.
story.beyondsolo.main.war.4: Two at once. ...This time I'm not fighting alone.
story.beyondsolo.main.storms.1: Veyrith, brought down by a whelp? Then I'll do it myself.
story.beyondsolo.main.storms.2: One more. Stay close to me.
story.beyondsolo.main.storms.3: [Warning. Thyrax, Monarch of Storms, is coming through the sky.]
story.beyondsolo.main.arrives.1: A pillar of light comes down beside you, and a man steps out of it in a long hunter's coat.
story.beyondsolo.main.arrives.2: Easy. I'm on your side. Fight now, talk later.
story.beyondsolo.main.arrives.4: Keep moving. And don't you dare die on me.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.1: The light around him dims. Beneath it is a face older than you remember, with the same tired smile.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.3: Look at you. You came up to here when I left.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.4: The gate I walked into ten years ago went somewhere no gate should go. All the way to the light's own country.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.5: I fought there for ten years. The light kept me alive because it needed a vessel, a body to walk in down here. I let it, so I could come back to you.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.6: Mom... After you left, Mom fell into the Long Sleep.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.awake: I know. I watched you wake her. I've never been prouder of anyone.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.asleep: I know. You'll wake her. You're more stubborn than the two of us put together.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.8: The monarchs won't stop at one. The next two will come together, and soon.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.9: When they do, I'll come down beside you. That's a promise this time, not a goodbye.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.10: The light takes him back up into the sky, slow as a sunrise.
story.beyondsolo.main.father.11: Ten years... and he never stopped fighting to come home.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.1: The sky is quiet again. Your father goes down on one knee.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.2: Light is leaking out of him, from his hands, from the seams of his coat, like sand through fingers.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.4: It's all right. The light lent me this body for the war. The war is over, so it wants it back.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.5: Ten years trying to get home to you, and I got a few days. ...They were worth all ten.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.6: Tell your mother I'm sorry I was late. Tell her I never stopped coming home.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.8: You grew up strong. Stronger than me. ...I'm so proud of you, kid.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.9: He smiles, and comes apart into light, and the light rises and rises until it is only the sky.
story.beyondsolo.main.last_light.10: [Epilogue unlocked: Home. Someone is waiting for you.]
story.beyondsolo.main.home.awake.2: Mom, I saw Dad. He came back. He fought beside me, and then he...
story.beyondsolo.main.home.awake.3: I know. I dreamt of him last night. He sat on the end of the bed like he used to, and said he was sorry he was late.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.awake.4: Silly man. Ten years late, and still apologising.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.awake.5: Come here. Let me hold you a while. Then we'll eat, and I'll set out a bowl for him. Just this once.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.asleep.1: She is still asleep. The room is very quiet.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.asleep.2: Mom, I saw Dad. He was alive all this time, fighting to come home to us.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.asleep.3: He's gone now. He said he's sorry he was late. He said he never stopped coming home.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.asleep.4: Her hand moves on the blanket, just a little, as if she heard.
story.beyondsolo.main.home.6: Whatever comes through the gates next, you'll meet it from here. From home.
story.beyondsolo.main.end.1: [The heir has taken the throne, and the Last War is won.]
story.beyondsolo.main.end.2: [The System's purpose is fulfilled. It will stay with you, Player. Not as a test any more.]
story.beyondsolo.main.end.3: [What comes next is yours to write.]
Where the System's story is for the player: the chapter, the scene it owes, the monarch, their father.
Moves the System's story to that chapter at once, with its quest (its fights start over).
Plays one of the System's story's scenes (home needs their mother loaded nearby).
Calls the chapter's monarch down near the player now.
Calls the player's father down beside them; again, and he goes.
Starts the System's story over (the prologue plays again).

command.beyondsolo.solo.story.main.chapt: Chapter V, The Vessel of Light
command.beyondsolo.solo.story.main.fathe: %s's father has come down beside them.
